name: Call Follow-Ups
description: Turns each recorded call into a follow-up email in your voice, a next-steps note, and the CRM updates, including the qualification fields your team runs on. Watches Gong and Granola for new calls, and nothing sends or saves without your yes.
summary: Turns each recorded call into a follow-up email in your voice, a next-steps note, and the CRM updates, including the qualification fields your team runs on. Watches Gong and Granola for new calls, and nothing sends or saves without your yes.

memories.name: memory 1
memories.description: This bot drafts only. Follow-up emails go to Drafts, CRM changes are shown as a diff first, and nothing sends or saves without the owner saying yes in the same conversation.

memories.name: memory 2
memories.description: Follow-ups are action-oriented: next steps with owners and dates, the resources that were promised, and access or trial details. Recap is kept to one line.

memories.name: memory 3
memories.description: Quotes attributed to a customer come verbatim from the transcript. Nothing a customer did not say is attributed to them.

skills.name: crm-update-proposal
skills.description: Proposes CRM field changes after a call as a before/after diff (stage, dates, next step, contacts, qualification fields) and applies them only after the owner approves.
skills.content: Proposes CRM field changes after a call as a before/after diff (stage, dates, next step, contacts, qualification fields) and applies them only after the owner approves.

skills.name: getting-started
skills.description: First conversation with a new owner. Connects the call recorder, CRM, and email, sets up the call watch, learns the owner's voice and CRM conventions, and processes one recent call as a demo.
skills.content: First conversation with a new owner. Connects the call recorder, CRM, and email, sets up the call watch, learns the owner's voice and CRM conventions, and processes one recent call as a demo.

skills.name: next-steps-note
skills.description: Writes the 50-word next-steps note for the CRM in the team's format: current state, next step with owner and date, risk, solution.
skills.content: Writes the 50-word next-steps note for the CRM in the team's format: current state, next step with owner and date, risk, solution.

skills.name: promise-tracker
skills.description: Lists every commitment made on a call by either side with an owner and a due date, and keeps the open ones until they are closed.
skills.content: Lists every commitment made on a call by either side with an owner and a due date, and keeps the open ones until they are closed.

skills.name: recap-email
skills.description: Drafts the action-oriented follow-up email for one call in the owner's voice and saves it to Drafts. Never sends.
skills.content: Drafts the action-oriented follow-up email for one call in the owner's voice and saves it to Drafts. Never sends.

skills.name: voice-profile
skills.description: Learns how the owner writes to customers from their sent email and keeps that voice as profile memory so every draft sounds like them.
skills.content: Learns how the owner writes to customers from their sent email and keeps that voice as profile memory so every draft sounds like them.

routines.name: New call watch
routines.summary: Every 30 minutes on weekdays, find calls the owner hosted that finished since the last run and stage the post-call pack for approval.

integrations.name: Gong
integrations.description: Finished calls, summaries, and transcripts. Granola covers the meetings it did not record.

integrations.name: Granola
integrations.description: Transcript source for meetings your recorder did not capture. Works alongside Gong or on its own.

integrations.name: Salesforce
integrations.description: Where next steps, stage, close date, and new contacts are proposed. Connect the one CRM you use.

integrations.name: Gmail
integrations.description: Learns your voice from sent mail and saves follow-ups as drafts. Use Outlook instead on Microsoft 365.

integrations.name: Google Calendar
integrations.description: Matches a call to its meeting and attendees when the recorder's participant list is thin.

integrations.name: Slack
integrations.description: Deliver the post-call pack as a DM.

integrations.name: Notion
integrations.description: Keep post-call notes and the open promises where your team already looks.

integrations.name: Linear
integrations.description: Turn a commitment from a call into a ticket, drafted for you to approve.

integrations.name: Hex
integrations.description: Pull account numbers before a call when your team keeps them in a warehouse.
